roles.title: Paving Crew Laborer
roles.text: Work behind the paver and on the ground: raking and luting hot mix, running a plate compactor, shoveling, setting up and cleaning up job sites. It is hot, physical work and it shows at the end of the day.
requirements: Shows up on time, every day
Can work outdoors in East Texas heat
Reliable ride to the yard in Longview

roles.title: Equipment Operator
roles.text: Run our paver, roller, dozer, backhoe and skid steer on paving and dirt work jobs. You will cut grade, build base and help the crew put down a mat that drains right.
requirements: Experience on at least one: paver, roller, dozer, backhoe or skid steer
Can read grade and work to a string line
Takes care of equipment like it is your own

roles.title: Dump Truck Driver
roles.text: Haul hot mix, base rock and fill to our jobs and help on the ground between loads.
requirements: Valid license for the truck you drive (CDL preferred)
Comfortable backing into tight residential sites
